subject: Structuring sponsor credits for Inkwell Labs — usage caps & milestone top-ups
messages:
From: Hannah Cole <h.cole@inkwell.ai>
To: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Rey <marcus@inkwell.ai>
Date: 2026-10-14T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Sponsor credits & packaging question

Hi Alex —

Thanks for the demo last week. We liked what we saw. Two quick asks as we finalize our internal commitment: can Redwood make an exception to the standard accelerator promo packaging? Specifically: 1) Can we get an initial sandbox credit pool (50k tokens equivalent) that does not count against our later dedicated conversion cap, and 2) is there a way to trigger an automatic top-up of an additional 100k tokens if we hit the milestone of 5 demo-ready models within 60 days?

Marcus and I are trying to keep legal and finance happy with predictable invoicing; they pushed back on ad-hoc credits that are hard to reconcile. If you have a structured example (SOW + billing path) we can circulate internally this afternoon.

Thanks,
Hannah Cole
Head of Platform Partnerships
Inkwell Labs

Attachments: none
From: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Cole <h.cole@inkwell.ai>
Cc: Marcus Rey <marcus@inkwell.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-14T11:35:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sponsor credits & packaging question

Hi Hannah — really appreciate the clear asks. Short answer: yes, we can model a two-bucket approach that keeps trial/sandbox credits separate from committed/dedicated conversion credits and we can attach milestone-driven top-ups — with a couple of guardrails for accounting and abuse prevention.

Proposed structure (high-level):
- Sandbox pool: 50k token-equivalent grant, expires 90 days, does not auto-convert.
- Conversion credit path: if Inkwell converts to Dedicated within 180 days, we can credit up to 75% of sandbox consumption toward the committed credit bucket (subject to min. conversion commitment).
- Milestone top-up: additional 100k token grant triggers when customer signals 5 models are production-ready (definition + evidence required). Top-up is time-limited (60 days after trigger) and requires a short attestation form.

To make finance comfortable: we propose the SOW include explicit billing lines and a simple credit escrow clause (credits issued off-invoice, consumed via dashboard, with a one-line reconciliation invoice at month-end). I attached a draft SOW and a usage projection template so you can populate expected model counts and token velocity.

Next steps: if this looks directionally right, can Marcus fill the attached usage projection and return it by EOD Wednesday? Ben and Priyom are cc'd to advise on discounting and operational constraints. I can then convert the SOW to a DocuSign-ready version.

Best,
Alex Martinez
Account Executive, Strategic Startups
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Inkwell_SOW_v2.pdf (stub), inkwell_usage_projection.csv (stub)
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-15T10:25:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: credit/discount guardrails for Inkwell (quick)

Alex / Priyom — quick internal note before we finalize the SOW to send back:
- I agree with the two-bucket approach; keep sandbox non-convertible by default but allow partial credit on committed conversion (cap at 75% as you suggested).
- Discounts: we can offer a 12% committed discount for a 12-month monthly usage commit tied to Dedicated conversion. If they want deeper discounting tied to user seats or ARR we need a deal desk approval (>20% effective discount).
- Milestone top-up mechanics: insist on objective evidence (model repo tags + a short acceptance checklist) and limit top-ups to once per customer cohort to avoid repeated ad-hoc grants.
- Accounting ops: require the customer to accept a one-time reconciliation invoice format (credits listed as negative line items) so Finance can map credits to cost centers.

If this aligns, I’m fine signing off — otherwise I recommend escalating to Emma (pricing lead) only if Inkwell asks for >100k in additional one-off credits or >20% discount.

—Ben
Head of Startup Partnerships (Sales Ops)
Redwood Inference
From: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Cole <h.cole@inkwell.ai>, Marcus Rey <marcus@inkwell.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-18T16:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sponsor credits & packaging question

Hannah / Marcus — thanks for the patience. Attached is a tightened SOW that reflects the two-bucket model and the milestone-triggered top-up we discussed. Key callouts in the SOW and pricing table:

1) Sandbox grant: 50k tokens, expires 90 days, non-convertible (shown as grant line item).
2) Conversion credit policy: up to 75% of sandbox consumption can be credited against the first 6 months of Dedicated committed usage if customer signs a 12-month dedicated agreement within 180 days.
3) Milestone top-up: 100k tokens granted upon submission of the model readiness attestation form and confirmation of 5 distinct model endpoints accessible in a staging environment. Top-up validity = 60 days.
4) Discount: 12% off unit rates for the 12-month committed plan; deeper discounts require separate approval (see Ben's note).
5) Billing: Credits will be recorded off-invoice and appear as negative line items on the month-end reconciliation invoice; we included an example reconciliation clause for Legal.

Links: HubSpot deal (https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/67890) and the Drive draft (https://drive.google.com/inkwell-pricing-draft) are live. If you approve, I'll generate the DocuSign and route to Legal for a quick thumbs-up. Marcus — if you can return the usage projection (inkwell_usage_projection.csv) by tomorrow morning we can embed numbers into the SOW and pull the DocuSign.

If you'd prefer a short call to walk the SOW line-by-line, I have availability Friday 10–11am PT.

Best,
Alex Martinez
Account Executive, Strategic Startups
Redwood Inference
